description: Ministry of Lands - Regulations made to amend the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013 Published in Gaz.Ex.ord. No. 1864/54 of 30.05.2014
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to regulations under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically modifying the Land Acquisition (Payment of Compensation) Regulations 2013. It deals with legal/regulatory matters by defining compensation procedures for specific expressway projects and redefining the term "Minister" in a legal context. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes or land transactions themselves.
